# EDI and finance

## Purpose

Lightweight **EDI** and **accounts payable** utilities adjacent to core supply chain menus.

## Screens

### Store ASN (`/ediasn`)

Manage or validate **ASN (advance ship notice)** store deliveries — EDI group.

### Unarchive invoice (`/unarchiveinvoice`)

**Account Payable** — restore archived invoice documents for AP investigation (finance group).

## Who may use it

Per `ICR_MENU_ACCESS_RULE` seeds — typically **Data integrity** for unarchive; EDI per deployment flags.
